title: The Home of Five
caption: THE OBSERVER WORLD — Chapter I, Episode 5: The Home of Five. The song broke into five notes, lost across the worlds. The Keeper brings each home to its place in the scale — and learns you cannot carry a note home; you make a home worth coming to. Music by Magnus.  the more you know, the more you observe.  #theobserver #animation #ambient #music #storytelling
